summary: The scene opens on an empty HOTEL LAFAYETTE room, the camera SPINNING COUNTER-CLOCKWISE around an old ringing PHONE. As the spin completes a full circle, the rest of the crew is revealed to now be standing in the room. Morpheus answers the ringing phone and, into it, says only, "We're in."

what_changes.before: The room is empty except for the spinning, ringing phone.
what_changes.after: The full crew is now standing assembled in the room, ready to act.
what_changes.evidence: everyone now standing there. Morpheus answers the phone. MORPHEUS We're in.

event_hint.one_line: The crew materializes inside the Matrix at the Hotel Lafayette and Morpheus confirms their arrival by phone.

uncertain: Who else is in the room besides Morpheus, since the text only says 'everyone'.
Who is on the other end of the phone call.
